**Build passes now.** It was failing, not just warning.

Two bugs, both from the bump:
1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it to `retryCount`. It now reads either name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was unset. The new loader leaves it `undefined`. Unset now means off, like before.

The 8 warnings are still printed. They name files this repo does not have. `build.js` writes them as fixed text. There is nothing to fix there.
